item.title: Morocco's Child Labor Fell 80% Since 1999 — But 101,000 Kids Still Work, State Council Warns
item.description: A landmark advisory-council report on child labor, a new Marrakech-Agadir-Essaouira high-speed rail declaration, land seized to widen the Kenitra-Marrakech line, and two MPs stripped of their seats for political defection — from Morocco’s Official Gazette issue №7541.

item.title: Six Moroccan Lawmakers Quit in Ten Days — Constitutional Court Declares Seats Vacant
item.description: Six Moroccan MPs resigned in ten days, the Constitutional Court moved fast to fill the gap, foreign-trained doctors got new equivalency routes, and three companies were licensed to farm shrimp, oysters and fish along the coast.
